title: NeMo RL draft co-training PR review

integration.summary: A non-PR integration branch will combine reviewed heads for the Qwen3-8B DFlash and DSpark matrix.

prs.title: Typed draft training contracts
prs.summary: Normalize existing single-pass EAGLE training behind a typed method boundary without changing tensor behavior.
prs.why: Later methods need one validated method identity without spreading conditionals through workers.
risks: Legacy YAML without method must retain EAGLE defaults.
prs.review_gate: Required before human review: on OCI-Hsg (primary GPU-capable host), run review-pr-team; post output, findings, and dispositions to the PR; resolve high-confidence issues with regression tests where applicable; request human review afterward.

prs.title: Streaming vocab-parallel soft CE
prs.summary: Add bounded-tile vocabulary-parallel soft cross entropy with explicit unnormalized draft loss statistics.
prs.why: DFlash, DSpark, and multi-pass EAGLE need loss bins that remain correct across tensor and data parallel reductions.
risks: Unequal pass or slot weights can expose an incorrect weighted denominator.
prs.review_gate: Required before human review: on OCI-Hsg (primary GPU-capable host), run review-pr-team; post output, findings, and dispositions to the PR; resolve high-confidence issues with regression tests where applicable; request human review afterward.

prs.title: DraftStepState and existing EAGLE split parity
prs.summary: Accumulate raw draft loss bins in DraftStepState and make current EAGLE synchronous and split training agree.
prs.why: Draft gradients and metrics must not inherit the policy-token denominator when microbatches are partitioned.
risks: Split workers require stable sample identities or an explicit precomputed plan payload.
prs.review_gate: Required before human review: on OCI-Hsg (primary GPU-capable host), run review-pr-team; post output, findings, and dispositions to the PR; resolve high-confidence issues with regression tests where applicable; request human review afterward.

prs.title: Optional draft optimizer overrides
prs.summary: Allow optional draft learning-rate and weight-decay overrides while preserving existing clipping groups.
prs.why: Draft parameters can need separate optimizer values without changing policy or no-draft behavior.
risks: Omitted overrides must preserve existing EAGLE optimizer groups exactly.
prs.review_gate: Required before human review: on OCI-Hsg (primary GPU-capable host), run review-pr-team; post output, findings, and dispositions to the PR; resolve high-confidence issues with regression tests where applicable; request human review afterward.

prs.title: Internal DFlash core
prs.summary: Build internal vectorized DFlash plans, structured attention, model forward/backward coverage, and checkpoint round trips.
prs.why: The DFlash model needs a dense-oracle-backed core before policy-worker or serving integration can be reviewed.
risks: Anchor planning must remain device-vectorized and avoid host synchronization in the draft hot path.
prs.review_gate: Required before human review: on OCI-Hsg (primary GPU-capable host), run review-pr-team; post output, findings, and dispositions to the PR; resolve high-confidence issues with regression tests where applicable; request human review afterward.

prs.title: DFlash co-training integration
prs.summary: Wire DFlash into training configuration, synchronous and split workers, and logical draft-weight export.
prs.why: The internal core becomes user-selectable only when its setup, normalization, and export contracts are validated together.
risks: Invalid gamma, mask, or hidden-state tap settings must fail before model construction.
prs.review_gate: Required before human review: on OCI-Hsg (primary GPU-capable host), run review-pr-team; post output, findings, and dispositions to the PR; resolve high-confidence issues with regression tests where applicable; request human review afterward.

prs.title: DSpark Markov extension
prs.summary: Add the Markov-only DSpark delta using shared DFlash visibility, attention, registry, and export wiring.
prs.why: DSpark has different query and label semantics but should not duplicate the DFlash core.
risks: The slot-zero next-anchor label and gamma-query contract are vulnerable to off-by-one errors.
prs.review_gate: Required before human review: on OCI-Hsg (primary GPU-capable host), run review-pr-team; post output, findings, and dispositions to the PR; resolve high-confidence issues with regression tests where applicable; request human review afterward.

prs.title: Bounded multi-pass EAGLE-3 TTT
prs.summary: Add bounded sequential EAGLE-3 passes with explicit pass state, RoPE plans, and memory gates.
prs.why: Existing single-pass EAGLE parity must hold at K=1 before larger pass counts are enabled.
risks: Retained KV memory must not grow quadratically with the configured pass count.
prs.review_gate: Required before human review: on OCI-Hsg (primary GPU-capable host), run review-pr-team; post output, findings, and dispositions to the PR; resolve high-confidence issues with regression tests where applicable; request human review afterward.

prs.title: Dual-version vLLM runtime and collective/IPC refit
prs.summary: Introduce a capability-driven vLLM runtime adapter, component manifests, and collective or IPC refit support.
prs.why: Training exports must load safely across vLLM 0.25.1 and 0.27.1 without probing one private runner layout.
risks: Unsupported runner, method, and pipeline-parallel combinations must fail during setup.
prs.review_gate: Required before human review: on OCI-Hsg (primary GPU-capable host), run review-pr-team; post output, findings, and dispositions to the PR; resolve high-confidence issues with regression tests where applicable; request human review afterward.

prs.title: Component-aware NCCL draft reshard
prs.summary: Route target and draft weights through component-aware NCCL reshard maps and preserve refit coverage checks.
prs.why: Draft tensor names cannot safely use target-only direct-transfer classification rules.
risks: Draft FFN names can be misclassified by target-only suffix matching.
prs.review_gate: Required before human review: on OCI-Hsg (primary GPU-capable host), run review-pr-team; post output, findings, and dispositions to the PR; resolve high-confidence issues with regression tests where applicable; request human review afterward.

prs.title: vLLM 0.27.1 default bump
prs.summary: Move the default vLLM dependency, lock files, and container pin to 0.27.1 while retaining 0.25.1 coverage.
prs.why: Semantic compatibility belongs in the adapter before the dependency-only default bump.
risks: Dependency changes must not introduce unrelated NeMo RL behavior changes.
prs.review_gate: Required before human review: on OCI-Hsg (primary GPU-capable host), run review-pr-team; post output, findings, and dispositions to the PR; resolve high-confidence issues with regression tests where applicable; request human review afterward.

quiz.question: Why does DraftStepState retain raw draft numerators and counts until step finalization?
quiz.explanation: The invariant is that draft normalization uses globally reduced draft bins, independent of microbatch partitioning.

quiz.question: How many DFlash queries are constructed for a block width gamma?
quiz.explanation: The invariant is that DFlash has one anchor-conditioning query plus gamma mask queries, while only gamma emitted tokens contribute to loss.

quiz.question: What makes DFlash anchor selection reproducible in split training?
options: Stable sample identity with seed, optimizer step, and slot
quiz.explanation: The invariant is that anchor plans depend on stable sample identity rather than local microbatch order.

quiz.question: When may NCCL refit transfer a draft tensor directly?
options: Whenever its name starts with draft
Only when both sides expose stable exact-layout live storage
Whenever the rank owns the target model
Only after converting it on the CPU
quiz.explanation: The invariant is that direct transfer is limited to stable exact-layout live storage; loader transformations use the misc path.

quiz.question: What must a DFlash or DSpark performance claim include?
options: End-to-end measurements including draft training and refit
quiz.explanation: The invariant is that performance claims include refit-inclusive end-to-end measurements under a matched matrix.
